newsitem.title: CHINA: China CITIC Bank profits hit 1.582 bln yuan in '96.
newsitem.headline: China CITIC Bank profits hit 1.582 bln yuan in '96.

text.p: CITIC Industrial Bank, a subsidiary of China's flagship multinational China International Trust and Investment Co, realised profits of 1.582 billion yuan ($190 million) in 1996, the Financial News said on Saturday.

The newspaper gave no details of whether the profits were pre- or post-tax, but CITIC officials said last October they expected the bank's net profits to rise 20 percent in 1996 from around 1.0 billion yuan the year before.
By the end of 1996, the bank's assets were worth 108.67 billion yuan, up 22.18 billion yuan or 25.7 percent from the year before, the Financial News said.
Total foreign currency savings at the bank soared 37.3 percent to 83.23 billion yuan, up 22.6 billion compared with the end of 1995, it said.
CITIC Industrial Bank had strengthened control of its lending policy and had moved to reform internal management, the newspaper said.
Group officials have said the banks relatively conservative lending policy has helped it hold the line against the bad debts that trouble much of China's state-owned banking sector.
